checkpoint_finding.source_revision_warning: The source code postdates all current graph datasets but contains no biological weights. Exposure is determined by each immutable local graph and training receipt.

held_source_feasibility.feasible_design: Remove one evidence source before metadata and graph construction and fit a generic candidate-gene scorer from remaining typed paths. The evaluator later measures recovery in the removed source.
held_source_feasibility.relation_specific_failure: HGT edge-type key/value transformations and attention priors for a wholly absent type receive no task evidence. A held-source-specific head or attention path cannot be queried as a learned predictor.
held_source_feasibility.seal_status: No current evidence source is project-sealed. Leave-one-source-out evaluation remains retrospective development evidence.

known_leakage_routes: Constructing the node/type universe or candidate list from entities observed only in the held source.

Retaining held-source inverse triplets, source nodes, type tokens, aliases, observability, coverage, missingness, prevalence, degrees, source counts, paths, attention masks, or graph-derived node features.
Fitting structural or positional encodings, metadata-dependent projections, feature normalization, negative pools, samplers, or early stopping before held-source and held-locus removal.
Keeping a held edge type in a source-specific output head or interpreting its untrained attention parameters as source recovery.
Encoding continuous evidence by outcome-selected type bins or treating untestable, not-applicable, unavailable, indeterminate, or absent edges as negatives.
Using attention coefficients as causal or mechanistic explanations.
Letting current Gene Catalog memberships, provisional COLOC outcomes, frozen 117 programs, or hero genes define targets, architecture, type schema, or calibration.
Adding an external knowledge graph without tracing whether it already contains project outcomes or deterministic derivatives.
Reporting attention heads, seeds, edges, genes, variants, cells, or guides as independent replicates.

license_disposition.project_weights: No upstream restriction, but redistribution remains conditional on every graph source's terms and project derivative-use review.

remaining_blockers: Complete and promote the corrected 50-study COLOC release, then freeze one graph snapshot, evidence ontology, ordered node and edge-type metadata, canonical node universe, source aliases, LD and locus groups, and source provenance.
Freeze source-independent feature transforms for every node type and a query fixture. HGT cannot induct to an unregistered node or edge type.
Freeze HGT depth, hidden dimension, head count, dropout, sampler, generic decoder, negatives, optimizer, early stopping, calibration, and five seeds.
Decide how continuous assay strength, evidence state, and observability are represented because HGTConv has no per-edge feature input. Do not outcome-bin values into relation types.
Implement source removal before metadata, attention masks, node features, graph statistics, sampling, and all other preprocessing.

Prove on synthetic fixtures that source-only nodes and types disappear, no-message node types fail explicitly, untestable edges never become negatives, inverse and alias leakage is rejected, metadata permutation preserves semantics, and unseen edge-type outputs are rejected.
Freeze tensor-only artifacts, graph and training receipts, environment, predictions, calibration, and hashes for every split and seed.
Run import, forward/backward, local fit, save/resume, seed determinism, empty-relation, metadata-order, sampler, CPU/L40S tolerance, and reproduction probes only through an approved SLURM campaign.
Keep all graph results development-only until a wholly sealed evidence source is registered and powered before outcomes are read.
